The answer is **B. Preterm birth complications**. In 2017, global estimates (IHME/GBD and WHO/UN IGME) put it at roughly 800,000 under-five deaths. That was ahead of lower respiratory infections (about 650,000–700,000), diarrheal diseases and malaria. The team note's two candidates are consistent with this, and diarrheal diseases ranked lower.

CONFIDENCE: 85
